source: Indiana Next Level Programs of Study (NLPS) Review Document, 2026–2027 (revised July 28, 2026)
howThisWorks: Each pathway lists its 4 NLPS steps by state course code. The site only shows courses whose code appears in a course guide, so courses FC doesn't offer are left out automatically. When more than one course is listed for a step, students choose one. 'note' is optional text shown with the pathway.

pathways.name: Biomedical Sciences and Technology
pathways.note: This pathway is new at FC, so only the first course is offered this school year. The next course in the pathway will be added each year until the full pathway is offered.
pathways._comment: NLPS also lists Anatomy & Physiology (5276) as a step-2 option. It is left out here because the Science guide lists its pathway as N/A.
